findings.text: The acceptance section assumes `tests/surface_select_procedure_test.py` holds the background check's budget test. That file has only the work-limit test of `sql_auto` (`SelectBudgetCases`), and the background check's budget tests are in `tests/surface_search_test.py` (`CounterexampleSearchBudget.lean`). Fix: name `tests/surface_search_test.py` for the budget tests, and name only the cancellation and excluded-rule tests in `tests/surface_select_procedure_test.py`, or call the work-limit test the budget test of `sql_auto`.
